text:
Noah B: Quick presales from ClienteSul — POC request: serve Brazilian customer requests from sa-east1 (São Paulo), BYOK keys must be resident in BR KMS, and DR to Canada (northamerica-northeast1) only for outages. Need short answers for SQ and a 1-page POC quote.
Elaine C: Hosted or Dedicated for POC? That changes pin options and pricing.
Noah B: They want Dedicated for predictable latency. Peak ~10 rps, ~55k tokens/day, 1 month.
Marco R: TL;DR: strict tenant-pin supported on Dedicated — compute+storage+logs can be kept in sa-east1. BYOK ok but requires customer-provisioned KMS key in BR and a BYOK addendum.
Marco R: If failover to CA happens, cloud inter-region egress applies. We bill token usage normally; any network egress is passed through as separate cost line.
legal-bot: BYOK addendum must cover custody, rotation, zeroization on termination, and permission to replicate anonymized metrics only if customer opts in. I can draft paragraph.
infra-oncall: quick health check (staging): `curl -s -I https://staging.sa-east1.redwood.ai/health` and `.../northamerica-northeast1/health`. To simulate failover: POST staging router override.
Elaine C: Pricing ask: 1) baseline Dedicated POC, 2) delta strict_pin vs prefer_with_failover, 3) conservative egress buffer for single outage. I can draft the one-pager.
Noah B: Owners: Elaine -> pricing one-pager, Marco -> tech runbook + instance sizing, legal-bot -> BYOK paragraph, infra-oncall -> region subproc list. EOD tomorrow?
Marco R: Ill include a sample YAML routing snippet and a short calc for worst-case egress.
Noah B: Perfect — scheduling customer call Fri 09:30 BRT after drafts. Thanks all :thumbsup:
